verdict.rationale: cfo.ai documents an official MCP server at https://api.cfo.ai/mcp. The docs include a `claude mcp add` setup command and an OAuth sign-in flow, and tools let agents read and edit the Model or hand questions to Ari. Clients named include Claude Code, Codex, and Claude desktop custom connectors. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP connection works in practice (probe only confirms the docs page exists).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: AI clients such as Claude Code and Codex can work on your Model through the cfo.ai MCP server.
claude mcp add --transport http cfoai https://api.cfo.ai/mcp
OAuth. A person approves the client in a browser, and the client sends the token it receives in the `Authorization` header.
an agent can read a company's financial Model and, when the user asks, change it: Pages, Table blocks, Canvas blocks, formulas, Variables, Dimensions
